title: Terminal Illness Accelerated Death Benefit Provision — Term Life Insurance
content:
### Eligibility

An insured certified by a licensed physician to have a life expectancy of the product's terminal illness months or less may receive part of the death benefit of a Term Life Insurance policy in advance, once per policy.

- An acceleration is paid only while the policy status on record is in force.
- An advance is paid only under an accelerated benefit claim whose request status is approved, which requires the written consent of every irrevocable beneficiary.

### Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis:

- "The elected amount may not exceed the lower of the product's maximum acceleration share of the face amount and the product's maximum acceleration amount less the amount already accelerated on the insured, and the face amount less the resulting lien may not fall below the product's minimum remaining face."
- "The amount paid is the elected amount reduced by the product's acceleration discount rate and then by the product's acceleration administrative fee, rounded to the cent; the lien is the full elected amount and earns no interest."

### Continuing provisions

Premiums continue to be due on the full face amount, and the lien is deducted from the death proceeds under the death claim provision.

| Check | Record read |
|---|---|
| Policy in force | the policy status on the policy record |
| Claim approved | the request status of the accelerated benefit claim |
| Terminal illness | the physician-certified life expectancy on the claim, at or below the product's figure |

superseded_clauses: The amount paid is the elected amount reduced by tiadb_discount_rate and then by tiadb_admin_fee, rounded to the cent; the lien is the full elected amount and earns no interest.

The elected amount may not exceed the lower of tiadb_max_pct of the face amount and tiadb_max_amount less term_msr_tiadb_accelerated_on_insured, and the face amount less the resulting lien may not fall below tiadb_min_remaining_face.
